# Pull Request Review Checklist

## Summary

Describe what this pull request adds or changes.

## Artifact Type

- [ ] Runbook
- [ ] Checklist
- [ ] Template
- [ ] Script
- [ ] Evidence guidance
- [ ] Documentation update

## Security Review

- [ ] No real client secrets included
- [ ] No Management API tokens included
- [ ] No production user exports included
- [ ] No unauthorized PII included
- [ ] Placeholders are used where needed

## Quality Review

- [ ] Steps are clear enough for a junior analyst
- [ ] Navigation paths are included
- [ ] Commands are included where needed
- [ ] Evidence requirements are included
- [ ] Rollback or escalation steps are included
- [ ] Owner/reviewer is identified

## Testing

- [ ] Markdown renders correctly
- [ ] Scripts are placeholders or tested safely
- [ ] Screenshots/evidence are sanitized, if included

## Reviewer Notes

Add notes here.
